name: ai-engineering-from-scratch
description: Learn it. Build it. Ship it for others.
one_liner: A free, structured, 500+ lesson online course that walks a beginner from zero to building real AI products, step by step.
buyer: Someone early in their career (bootcamp grad, junior developer) who wants to break into AI engineering but doesn't know where to start and can't afford an expensive bootcamp.
business_use_cases: A coding bootcamp uses it as free curriculum inspiration, then sells a paid cohort with live mentorship on top of it.
A corporate L&D team assigns it to upskill existing developers into AI engineering roles instead of buying an expensive course license.
A career coach builds a paid '90-day AI engineer' program using this as the free backbone plus 1:1 coaching.

money_ideas.idea: Sell a paid cohort-based version with live mentorship, code review, and a certificate on top of the free lessons.
Offer ongoing paid community/office-hours access for people working through it.

steal_this: Launch a paid 'accountability cohort' this weekend: charge a small group to work through the free curriculum together with weekly live check-ins.
